items.title: Europol-backed operation shuts down KillSec ransomware
items.summary: Police took over KillSec's dark web leak site on October 1, secured at least 110 TB of data stolen from victims, and identified the group's alleged teenage leader.

items.title: Slate Valley Unified School District (US) — Kairos
items.summary: The Kairos group listed the Vermont school district as a victim, with the claim discovered on October 1, 2026.

items.title: Baltimore Freightliner (US) — Settra
items.summary: The Settra group posted truck dealer baltimorefreightliner.com to its leak site, appearing among the tracker's newest entries on October 2.

items.title: Krybit posts four victims across three countries
items.summary: Krybit listed kres.cz (Czechia), raajratna.com and sai.org.in (India), and pierrefeu.fr (France) in a single batch dated October 2.

items.title: Econ-Tec (Mexico) — SafePay
items.summary: SafePay claimed an attack on the Mexican engineering firm Econ-Tec on September 30, 2026.

items.title: CYFIRMA weekly: Qilin and The Gentlemen hit Asian manufacturers
items.summary: The October 1 weekly report highlights Qilin impacting a Japanese electronics manufacturer and The Gentlemen targeting a manufacturing company in Thailand (victims not named in the summary).

ransomware.note: Leak-site claims are unverified by the victims unless stated. A reported The Gentlemen claim against Metalware Corporation (Canada) was left out: it could not be confirmed on the tracker.

items.title: Azure network disruption hits ExpressRoute and VPN Gateways in 18 regions
items.summary: A self-inflicted network disruption starting 20:30 UTC September 30 knocked out ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway and Azure VMware connectivity across 18 regions until 02:15 UTC October 1 (5 hours 45 minutes).

items.title: Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry outage in Sweden Central
items.summary: From 10:00 UTC September 29, Azure OpenAI Service, AI Foundry Agent Service, AI Foundry Models and Cognitive Services failed in Sweden Central, leaving customers with failed API calls for nearly six hours.

outage.note: Both items are Azure incidents from the past four days; no AWS, Google Cloud or Cloudflare incident dated October 2026 surfaced in today's searches.

items.title: Fortinet FortiMail zero-day CVE-2026-104286 added to CISA KEV
items.summary: The CVSS 9.8 flaw lets unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files on the underlying system and is being exploited; federal agencies must patch or mitigate by October 4, 2026.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager authentication bypass added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a critical authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following reports of active exploitation.

items.title: Bitget: $387.5M theft exploited zero-day in third-party security products
items.summary: The cryptocurrency exchange confirmed that the attackers who stole $387.5 million last week exploited a zero-day flaw in third-party security products.

items.title: KEV additions span Check Point, Arista, F5 and Citrix edge products
items.summary: Recent KEV additions include exploited flaws in Check Point, Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager and Citrix NetScaler ADC; several date from late September.

items.title: Tropical Storm Nolo strengthening west of Hawaii
items.summary: As of the October 1 8:00 AM HST advisory Nolo had 60 mph winds about 385 miles west of Lihue, with a Tropical Storm Warning for Papahanaumokuakea from Nihoa to Maro Reef and a possible hurricane by the weekend.

items.title: Major Hurricane Rachel active in the Eastern Pacific
items.summary: A storm tracker listed Rachel as a Category 3 hurricane with 115 mph winds on October 2, the strongest of nine named systems it was tracking across the Atlantic and Pacific.

items.title: Hurricane Polo remnants bring flash flooding to Arizona
items.summary: Polo made landfall in Mexico's Baja California Sur as a Category 2 storm with 110 mph winds before its remnants fuelled flash flooding in Arizona; the source gives no exact landfall date.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake — 80 km ENE of Tadine, New Caledonia
items.summary: Struck September 25; USGS PAGER alert green and no tsunami flagged.

items.title: M 4.2 earthquake — 6 km WNW of Wauna, Washington
items.summary: Struck September 29 in the Puget Sound area; USGS PAGER alert green and no tsunami flagged.

physical.note: Storm details for Rachel and Polo come from a third-party tracker, not an NHC advisory; verify against nhc.noaa.gov before acting on them.
